objective: Make due-task in-app reminders retry-safe, scoped to current assignment and schedule, with operator health and recovery.
scope: Due follow-up task reminder delivery and durable deduplication
Role-scoped reminder inbox, worker heartbeat and recovery
Feature tests, isolated browser verification and deployment instructions
outOfScope: Appointment/application reminder activation before CAL-01/CASE-01 acceptance
Production worker activation, VPS deployment or Ghost cutover

acceptance.description: Due open tasks notify the current active CRM assignee once across retries and concurrent workers
acceptance.evidence: 17 focused engine/runner tests pass for deterministic private delivery, current active CRM assignee, concurrency, retries/lost acknowledgments and preserved read state.

acceptance.description: Completion, cancellation, rescheduling and assignment changes invalidate stale reminders and enforce stale-write checks
acceptance.evidence: 12 focused workflow tests pass for Complete/Cancel/Reschedule, current version and permission checks, normalized schedules, audit-first writes and current assignment. Built-app browser lifecycle/invalidation passed.

acceptance.description: Inbox and read actions revalidate current lead/task scope and never expose another recipient’s notices
acceptance.evidence: Workflow tests verify recipient/current-owner/source checks, foreign and content-role denial, deleted/legacy records and older-page cursors. Browser confirmed Read leaves task open and stale notices disappear.

acceptance.description: Worker health, failure isolation, graceful stop and fail-closed crash recovery are tested and documented
acceptance.evidence: Engine/runner tests cover per-record isolation, health/query failure, contention, fail-closed abandoned locks and safe stop. Added operator health UI, six-minute PM2 stop grace and explicit recovery/rollback runbook.

acceptance.description: Focused tests, isolated browser workflow, schema readiness, typecheck/build and continuation notes pass
acceptance.evidence: Final session:verify passed all 86 tests, typecheck and production build. Built-app synthetic browser workflow, fixture CLI --once and actual offline CLI SIGTERM shutdown passed. Live disposable schema/query/private-access check passed with cleanup. Vault links, credential scan, whitespace and 15 shell blocks passed.

nextActions.action: Archive this completed REMIND-01 state and start bounded CASE-01 verification. Check application creation/update, education versus immigration fields/stages, current lead scope, stale writes and assignment transfer. Do not activate case reminders until accepted.

Keep VPS activation separate. When the target edge/access is available, execute first-day CRM and reminder runbooks with controlled synthetic staff workflows, recorded rollback commit, health and reboot smoke checks. Publishing/Ghost cutover remain separately gated.

knownRisks: Appointment/case reminders remain disabled until CAL-01/CASE-01 acceptance; external provider delivery is not configured.
Crash-left cycle/lead locks fail closed; recovery requires stopping their owners before targeted operator removal. No expiry takeover.
Task creation/change audit acknowledgments can be ambiguous; inspect recorded task ID/current version before retrying to avoid duplicate work.
Reminder inbox scans 25 stored records per page; task lists still cap at 100. Recurrence/escalation/snooze and provider outbox remain follow-up features.
Runtime health is stale after three minutes without a recorded cycle; a long cycle or delayed clock can also cause stale status. No external alerting provider is configured.
VPS deployment, Nginx/TLS/PM2 reboot smoke checks and production worker activation remain unperformed.
Development branch still contains unaccepted cases/calendar/documents/team/reporting modules; whole-branch main merge is gated.
